strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Gandor destroyed
Took long enough to get here...! Heh heh, there they are.
Just as I thought... the Einst have taken over Jaburo.
So the base is an Einst nest.
I saw it coming, but with this many of them, it's going to be trouble.
But if we can just win here... we'll take Jaburo back.
...Show me... what you really are...!
Domon! The God Gundam's tuned to perfection!
All right! Come fooorth, Gundaaam!
Whoa, no idea what's up, but he's sure fired up.
We're going too!
All units, launch!
The Devil Gundam... where is Master Asia!?
Th-the Devil Gundam? It's going to show up here!?
Schwarz says the Devil Gundam is here.
That's... it's a tough enough opponent as it is.
It'll be fine!
We already beat it once, didn't we? We'll send it packing again!
...Everyone, listen. It seems the Gandor has come as far as it can.
Commander? What do you mean?
Come to think of it, you started to say something earlier. What's going on?
Don't tell me you've lost your nerve, Commander.
No... before long... the Gandor won't be able to move.
Whoa, whoa, what's that supposed to mean? Nobody told us that.
The dragon's life is 180 days and three.
The Gandor's Achilles' heel... its fusion reactor has reached its limit.
Commander... you never said a word about this to us...
After this battle, we'll send you up into space... By my math, it'll be close.
Fine if this were the last battle. But space is still full of enemies...
Geez... I can't tell if this planet's science level is high or low.
Storming Emperor Burai's Science Fortress Island took its toll, too.
Oh well, never mind.
So, Commander, we protect the Gandor and beat the enemy, right?
Ya make it sound real easy, missy, but it ain't no joke!
But we have to do it anyway, right?
Juzo! Impossible or not, we're doing it!
All riiight! Let's wrap this up before some nasty customer shows up!
Looks like there's no time to dawdle... We'll finish them in one go!
Not yet... we still can't beat it...
Dammit! How are we supposed to beat something like this!
Today's the day! I'll surpass you!!
...Very well...
Now... you are truly... the King of Hearts...
D-did I do it!?
Ugh... magnificent... Domon... You've grown strong... truly strong...!
H-he just won't stay down!
Hyoma! Wait!
Master Asia is already...
...Why... why did you have to change...
Domon...
My...! My master was never a man who'd want humanity wiped out!
Heh... heh heh... Domon... Long ago, for the path I believed in...
...I fought the enemies of Earth... for the sake of this beautiful Earth...
...I've never heard of such a thing. Could it really...
...As those who inherit the name King of Hearts...
...we have no wish to step into history's spotlight...
So long as this Earth never loses its radiance... that... that is enough...
That's right... the Master Asia I knew was that kind of man! So why!
...One day... I realized... the more I fought...
...the more the Earth was wounded...
The Earth was wounded!?
I see... once a battle starts, the damage spreads all around...
Even so... we can't just leave the enemy alone, can we!?
Dummy... Not everyone's as simple as you, Koji...
How naive... Is anything more important than wiping out the enemy?
His goal... isn't wiping out the enemy, Tetsuya...
Y-you... that's how you saw it...
I regretted what I had done... I grieved... and then...
...it seems I arrived at the wrong answer...
N-no! You're... you're not wrong!
That's right... nobody holds the right answer.
Master Asia... was just too pure.
...Domon... do not... repeat... my mistake...
Hmm! I still need more training.
So you've made it this far... Gandor team!
There you are! Undefeated of the East, Master Asia!!
Just as Schwarz said... he came to Jaburo.
Heh heh heh... Kyoji wanted to come here, you see.
What!?
Look, Domon! Behold your brother, no better than a corpse!
There it is! The Devil Gundam!!
Wh-what...? Has it almost fully recovered!?
This is the price of defeating the Devil Gundam in the Guiana Highlands!
The price!?
Even the Devil Gundam, with its pilot, its living unit, in this state,
...is no better than scrap metal!
Living unit?
The pilot is infected by DG Cells and becomes the Devil Gundam's core...
In that state, Kyoji's consciousness is already...
And so, Domon, you shall become its new pilot
...and bring the Devil Gundam fully back to life!
What!?
How could you!
I've waited for this moment! Myself! The revived Devil Gundam!
And you, Domon! All of us gathered in one place!!
What!?
You mean you used the Einst!?
Yes! Birthing the perfect Devil Gundam is my wish!
No matter how many times it revives, I'll destroy the Devil Gundam!
And Master Asia! I'll settle things with you here and now!!
Big talk, Domon!
As if the likes of you could defeat the revived Devil Gundam!!
Captain!
All units, spread out and stop the Devil Gundam in its tracks!
Grr... as I thought, their power is...! ...Hm!?
More robots run by AI!?
Heh, I didn't expect they'd let us off that easy...
The Einst, is it...? Meddling fools!
Mechanical Beasts, Hyakki Mechs, and...
The Demon Empire's combining mechs. They never get tired of this, huh...!
Mister, gripe later!
Tch, that thing... why won't it show up at a time like this!?
The Bloody I!? Where did they get those...! Something's wrong...
Hardly any of those should have come down to Earth.
Unless the Bunker group is helping them... their design was stolen...
It's possible. But...!
We'll show 'em it's the pilot who breathes life into a machine!
Now you're talkin'! Let's go!
You fools!
You don't even understand what that great power of yours means!
What!? What do you mean!
A man who inherited the title King of Hearts, of all people,
can't even grasp that...! What did you learn from me!?
...What's he talking about?
...Domon.
What I... what I learned from Master Asia, the last King of Hearts...
...was strictness and kindness... And from that, I reached only one answer!
Master Asia! It's to defeat you!!
You fool! As you are now, you cannot defeat me!
Give up and become the Devil Gundam's living unit!!
No! Well said, Domon!
I won't let the likes of you have my little brother!
What!?
Domon's brother!?
B-but... then...
Who's inside the Devil Gundam...?
No! It-it was definitely
...Kyoji, my brother, inside the Devil Gundam!?
...Domon! We can't let the Devil Gundam fall into his hands!
Destroy it here!
B-but... who are you!? Are you really my brother?
Hmph! Schwarz... your true identity! It's just as I thought!
Hm... this is bad!
All units, stay alert! The Master Gundam could appear at any moment!
Kasshu, for now, focus on destroying the Devil Gundam!
If the Master Gundam shows up now... we can't protect the Gandor!
R-right...
Don't give up! There's still a way!
Schwarz!?
What are you going to do!?
Domon! Strike down Kyoji!
Schwarz is in the Devil Gundam's cockpit!
Th-that's crazy!
Unless you strike down Kyoji, its living unit, it can't be beaten.
Aim for the cockpit!
B-but then... you'll also...
Stay out of my way! Kyoji!
H-here it comes! The Master Gundam!
What... what's going on here!? Why are there two of my brother!?
...Domon... Now I'll tell you everything.
I am Kyoji, and yet not Kyoji... a body and mind split in two...
Kyoji's shadow, you might say!
His shadow!?
Yes... because I was created with the power of DG Cells,
...I am nothing more than a copy of Kyoji...
What!?
DG Cells... can they really do that...
It was all to destroy the Devil Gundam.
But... it was supposed to be you who tried to conquer the universe with it...
That's not true!
The Devil Gundam was originally built to regenerate the Earth!
Regenerate the Earth!?
Yes. Father's Ultimate Gundam and its Three Great Theories...
Self-Regeneration, Self-Multiplication, Self-Evolution, all meant
...to restore the Earth's nature... But!
...someone had their eye on that astonishing power...
...N-no way!?
I boarded the Ultimate Gundam and fled to Earth,
...but the impact of the fall corrupted its program... and then,
...it became that terrifying Devil Gundam...
Then the story that you stole the Devil Gundam was...!?
A fabrication by Dr. Mikamura and Ulube!
Ulube...!? Then this was all Neo Japan's doing?
So it was my father... but... he couldn't have done such a thing!?
...Dr. Mikamura wanted the Ultimate Gundam's Three Great Theories...
Ulube took advantage of that, and it seems he lent him a hand...
B-but... for that, Domon, Kyoji, the whole Kasshu family...
...were put through such cruelty... I... I...
...Rain...
It's not your fault, Rain...
I-I'm sure your father was tricked by Ulube too.
No... we didn't know any of that... and we chased the Devil Gundam...
...and chased my brother...
...Domon... I'm sorry...
R-Rain... B-but, brother!
Then why didn't you tell me from the start!?
Heh... hot-blooded as you were, no matter how much I explained,
...you wouldn't have understood.
...Brother... I...
Besides, destroying the Devil Gundam came first... And I feared for you.
Knowing you... you'd do something reckless to defeat the Devil Gundam...
So even as the Devil Gundam absorbed him, Kyoji created me,
...to protect you!
How... harrowing...
B-brother... you really are my brother...!
Domon... it was hard for me too!
Tch! To me, how we got here doesn't matter!
Ah!? Look out!
DG Cells in Schwarz's body!?
No, it means to absorb me too! Domon, fire!
Hit the Devil Gundam, along with me!
Wha-!?
Hurry! Blow away the cockpit, with me in it!
No... I don't want to! I can't do it!
Don't be so soft!
A man who'd inherit the King of Hearts mustn't be swayed by emotion
...and lose sight of your goal!
Or are you fine with tragedies like Kyoji's happening again!?
And just when the misunderstanding was cleared up...
Isn't there... isn't there some other way!?
Do it! To free us from the Devil Gundam's curse!
B-brother...
Domon! Don't let your brother's feelings go to waste!
Big Bro! Isn't there anything we can do!?
Even if you say that... dammit.
...But that's the only way to save Kyoji...
Domon...
...Domon!
Brother... I... I...!
Stop, Domon. Would you slay your own brother with your own hands!?
Please, Domon... the final blow to the Devil Gundam!!
...All right...
Stop, Domooon! Without the Devil Gundam, humanity's future is...!
...Brother!!
Stooop!
Domon!
Dammit, isn't there anything we can do!?
...Brother...!!
...Thank you.
Domon...
Brotheeer!
Tobikage!?
What!? Don't tell me!?
...Ugh.
B-brother!?
Huh...!? No way... in that one instant...!?
Im-impossible! It saved only the living unit!? Curse you!
It seems things aren't going the way you wanted...
Brother!?
A shinobi dies leaving no corpse... but don't die until your mission's done, eh?
The Devil Gundam!?
No... readings.
But Schwarz's body is...
...A life saved by a fellow ninja... I'll let it burn once more!
My... my Devil Gundam... I'll never forgive you, Domooon!
Do you fools even know what you've done!?
Silence! Master Asia!
What?
You villain, plotting to take the world for yourself with the Devil Gundam!
Fool! When did I ever say I wanted such a thing!!
Then why are you working with the Einst to destroy things?
The Einst? Those women wanted to study the Devil Gundam!
As long as the Devil Gundam could be revived, that was enough for me!
We used each other, nothing more!!
Then why do you need the Devil Gundam!
...You wish to know? Then I'll teach you the only way I know: a duel!
You fools haven't even realized who it is
...that has done this to the Earth!
Domon! What have you seen on your way to Jaburo!
Kyoto! New York!
Have you not seen with your own eyes what's become of the world!?
That's... no, that's exactly why we...!
No, what Master Asia's trying to say is... something else...
When I realized it, I could no longer
...stand by and watch the Earth like this. And I swore then...
...that whatever it took, I'd return this Earth to its natural form!
Say what?
Isn't that a good thing?
You mean regenerating the Earth?
Fools! Regenerate the Earth? Nothing so half-hearted!
My goal is the extermination of humanity!
What!?
Regenerating Earth and wiping out humanity... how do they connect?
He's saying the ones polluting the Earth... are us humans.
Get rid of humanity, then use the Devil Gundam's Three Great Theories
...to regenerate the Earth...
Exactly! What good are colonies! What good is developing Mars!
They're nothing but artificial worlds! And even with those worlds in hand!
In the end, humanity is still destroying this Earth!!
Gwah... Hack, hack...
Master Asia!?
Blast! If only this body were sound, it would have been no trouble at all!
I could have become part of the Devil Gundam myself... How it galls me!
Why! Your fists right now are overflowing with sorrow!
...Domon!?
The fist expresses one's soul... You're the one who told me that...
...Silence! Domon!!
Why can't you see that humanity must atone to the Earth with death!!
You're wrong!
Master Asia! You are mistaken!
What?
Because the humanity you seek to wipe out
...was also born from nature itself... part of the Earth, you could say!
Forgetting that, how can you call it regenerating nature, the Earth!
Yes! A paradise built by wiping out the humans who share it is utter folly!
...Hmph. Then whether I am right or you are,
...we shall settle it here!
I'll win this fight! On my name as the King of Hearts!!
Maaasteeer!
Domon...
Not yet! There may still be enemy forces left!
That's right, Domon! Don't let your guard down yet!
...Domon...
Ugh...!
Wh-what is this...!?
Captain!? Kamille!? What's wrong!
This is...!
Ah... ahh...
Cham? Show! Something's wrong with Cham!
What's wrong, Cham! Hey!
Wh-what is this feeling...!? It's so intense... like nothing before...
It's huge... what the heck is this thing...!
Don't underestimate us! We've fought plenty of things that were just big...!
We won't lose!
Showing up now, of all times...! The Devil Gundam is... already...!
Hey, this is bad! Isn't the Gandor stuck?
This dragon still has work left to do... We can't fall here!
Everyone, hurry back to the Gandor!
Devil... Added... Body... Experiment...
What...!? Again! What... did it just say!?
Kyosuke!? What's wrong with ya!
Tch, what's this, you scared!?
We've made up our minds to smash whatever shows up!
Some of you are acting weird, huh? Hey, hey, what's wrong!
We can't exactly say we're scared and go home now!
We've never seen this one before. Koji, you need to be a little careful...!
What? Morale's falling apart! What's so special about this thing!
I don't know. But... when these things first appeared...
...some people fell into the same state.
It's certainly intimidating... but... the ones affected are
...our two finest Newtypes... the psychics Alice and Asuka,
...Cham... and Nanbu!? What on earth...
Th-this is...!? Everyone!
This Einst is giving off the same pattern as DG Cells!!
Good grief... these guys'll use anything...
Looks like that's the Einst ringleader!
There's no turning back now! Everyone, all-out attack!
...This... could become... a new...?
Did we... win?
...No readings nearby. No enemies... in sight!
We won... but...
Master...
Domon... if Master Asia hadn't been stopped, humanity might be gone...
You two traded that many blows...
I'm sure your master understood how you felt, Domon...
...What on earth... are the Einst after...
...Kyosuke?
No... it's nothing.
All units, return to the Gandor... We head for space at once!
What, already!? Commander, you're rushin' it...
Yeah! We only just got to catch our breath.
We still haven't been able to reach Londo Bell...
They've probably already begun their assault on the plant planet.
Knowing Bright and the others, I hope they're not doing anything reckless...
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Acquired skill "Lucky".
Acquired skill "Command".
